definitions.gloss: passenger ship; cruise ship; ocean liner
definitions.explanation: A ship designed primarily for carrying passengers, including ferries and cruise ships.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{客船|きゃくせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧きた。
examples.english: A large passenger ship entered the harbor.

examples.japanese: {客船|きゃくせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{地中海|ちちゅうかい}→地中海：20770_chichuukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧⟦ツアー→ツアー：08285_tsuaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I joined a tour cruising the Mediterranean on a passenger ship.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{客船|きゃくせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二千人|にせんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乗|の}れる→乗る：00511_noru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: I hear this cruise ship can carry two thousand passengers.

notes:
USAGE:
Distinguished from ⟦{貨物船|かもつせん}→貨物船：22204_kamotsusen⟧ (cargo ship). {客船|きゃくせん} covers everything from ferries to luxury cruise liners.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{客船|きゃくせん} (large passenger ship)
- ⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧{客船|きゃくせん} (luxury cruise ship)
- {客船|きゃくせん}⟦ターミナル→ターミナル：11037_taaminaru⟧ (passenger ship terminal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦フェリー→フェリー：11168_ferii⟧: ferry — a specific type of passenger ship for regular routes
- ⟦{貨物船|かもつせん}→貨物船：22204_kamotsusen⟧: cargo ship — a ship primarily for freight
